court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Amador
case_search_note: Online Case Search and Payments (linked from amador.courts.ca.gov/online-services/case-search-and-payments). Criminal and traffic cases are searchable; confidential case types (sealed, juvenile, mental health, etc.) are not online.

sources.title: Amador Superior Court — Case Search and Payments
CA Dept. of Insurance — Check Agent/Broker

courthouses.name: Amador Superior Court (Jackson)
courthouses.hours: Courthouse public access 8 a.m.–3 p.m. per Criminal page; clerk by phone 9 a.m.–3 p.m. Mon–Fri
courthouses.note: Only courthouse in the county. Criminal direct line (209) 257-2604 / phone tree (209) 257-2630, criminal@amadorcourt.org. Traffic direct (209) 257-2605 / phone tree (209) 257-2660, traffic@amadorcourt.org. Note: the Criminal page lists 209-257-2605 as the clerk number, which the Contact page labels Traffic — numbers conflict, try both.

public_defenders.name: Court-appointed Public Defender (Amador County)
public_defenders.note: Court's Criminal page: if you cannot afford an attorney, ask the court to appoint one; the court may appoint a Public Defender, and the judge decides how much (if any) of the fees you repay.
public_defenders.todo: No official Public Defender contact page found (amadorcounty.gov has no PD department page). A third-party list (EBCLC) gives 201 Clinton Road Suite 202, Jackson, (209) 223-0877 — NOT verified on an official page, not used.

legal_aid.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Auburn Office
legal_aid.serves: Low-income residents of Amador, Calaveras, El Dorado, Nevada, Placer and Sierra counties
legal_aid.what: Free CIVIL legal help — housing and public benefits (CalWORKs, CalFresh, Medi-Cal, General Assistance, SSI/Social Security, unemployment, SDI). Not criminal defense; page does not mention record clearing.
legal_aid.hours: Intake Mon–Thu 9 a.m.–12 p.m. and 1:15–4 p.m.; no new intakes Fridays

probation.name: Amador County Probation Department
probation.note: Fax (209) 223-6403, amadorprobation@amadorcounty.gov. Same phone is listed by the court for the Alternative Sentencing Program.

programs.name: Probation Pretrial Supervision
programs.summary: Amador Probation's Adult Services says it provides offender supervision services 'including pretrial'. Details/check-in rules not published — follow your release order and ask Probation.

programs.name: Alternative Sentencing Program (Probation + Sheriff)
programs.summary: People sentenced to jail are assessed to see if they can serve the sentence another way — community service or GPS monitoring. Non-compliance can mean return to jail custody.

programs.name: Workforce Assistance Placement Program (WAPP)
programs.summary: For eligible people on probation: partnership with Mother Lode Job Training — pre-employment screening, then a paid 90-day work-site placement (can be extended).

jails.name: Amador County Jail
jails.phone_note: Sheriff main office. Jail line for special-housing visit appointments: (209) 223-6521 (Fridays from 8 a.m.). Non-emergency dispatch (209) 223-6513.
jails.note: State-rated capacity 76 (65 male, 11 female). Visits: men Sat 8:30–10:30 a.m. & 12:30–3:30 p.m., Sun 12:30–5:30 p.m.; women Sat 3:30–5:30 p.m., Sun 8:30–10:30 a.m.; special housing Fri by appointment. Deposits: SmartDeposit online or (866) 394-0490 (Facility Code JAQ, Pay Location #5500) or lobby kiosk Mon–Fri 8–5 and during visiting; front counter/mail deposits not accepted. court_ids: nearest criminal courthouse, not confirmed.

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' (linked from insurance.ca.gov CheckAgntBrkr page) — look up any bail agent's license status. Amador Sheriff jail page gives no bail amounts or bond procedure; call the jail/Sheriff at (209) 223-6500. Not verified: where/when cash bail is accepted.
